fixed_findings.action_taken: Declared 04_decomposition.R as a dependency of 06_figures.R in the dependency graph.

Rewrote every script's produces list to match the files it writes (HTML tables, PNG copies, joint-tests.json, fit statistics, identifying-cell counts, SE sensitivity, RDS model objects, model-fit-stats.csv).
Dependency graph now has 06 <- {03, 04} and 07 <- {01, 03, 04, 05}; uses lists updated; script order unchanged.

03_main_models.R now re-estimates the S03 and S04 standard errors clustered by industry-year and two-way (occupation + industry-year) and writes analysis/outputs/se-sensitivity.csv. It also writes identifying-cell counts by source (analysis/outputs/identifying-cells-by-source.csv), addressing ROB-003.
Special-code flags use %in% and so are never NA.
Added stopifnot(!is.na(topcode), topcode >= 50) after parsing the top code.
Added p10_topcoded and median_topcoded flags and coverage counts.
Replaced the deprecated geom_errorbarh() with geom_errorbar(orientation = 'y', width = 0.2).
interaction(..., drop = TRUE) in the S08 composition benchmark.
